steps.title: The market
steps.say: Buyers' demand and sellers' supply meet at one price. Demand slopes down and supply slopes up.

ops.text: Demand rises: what happens to the price?

steps.title: Starting equilibrium
steps.say: The market clears at a price of 5 and a quantity of 5. This is the equilibrium.

steps.title: Demand shifts right
steps.say: Demand rises, so buyers want more at every price. The demand curve moves right.

steps.title: Why the price rises
steps.say: At the old price of 5 there is now a shortage: buyers want more than sellers offer. Competition for the goods pushes the price up until supply and demand meet again at a higher price and a higher quantity.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.say: Drag the demand curve or the supply curve and watch where the new equilibrium lands.
